Actual evaluated vertex projection depth along the declared unit normal must remain in the original interval. Raw convex outer envelopes only prove separation; envelope overlap never proves actual contact.

installation_geometry_method_scope.new_geometry_representation: For all fourteen objects and both raw/evaluated actual captures, convert each captured local binary64 component and each actual saved/evaluated matrix binary64 component exactly to Fraction. Form every world vertex by exact rational affine multiplication and addition; retain original captured triangle indices. This defines the actual saved mesh under its stored transform without an extra world-array rounding operation.
installation_geometry_method_scope.bounds_policy: Fraction min/max and exact predicates throughout. Any call to a binary64-only broad-phase or star helper must receive a proven outward enclosure (lower <= exact lower; upper >= exact upper). Unproved inward rounded bounds cannot establish separation.
installation_geometry_method_scope.rounded_render_export_limitation: Renderer/exporter world-coordinate rounding may produce distinct derived geometry. Offline art review, bounds/material roundtrip and this exact-affine query do not prove exact face incidence or zero penetration in subsequently rounded render/export meshes.
